_comment: ProfileVerifier rules — applied after hard disqualification, before ML pipeline.
_scoring: Every candidate starts at 1.0. Each fired rule deducts its penalty. Floor is 0.0. Score feeds ML pipeline as a credibility multiplier.

integrity_rules.description: Claimed years_of_experience significantly exceeds what career history accounts for.
integrity_rules.flag_message: Claims {claimed_yoe} yrs but career history accounts for only {computed_yoe} yrs.

integrity_rules.description: A degree completed in fewer years than standard (B.Tech/B.E. < 3.5 yrs, M.Tech < 1.5 yrs).
integrity_rules.flag_message: Degree '{degree}' from {institution} completed in {actual_years} yrs (minimum {min_years} yrs).

integrity_rules.description: A degree completed in significantly more years than standard maximum.
integrity_rules.flag_message: Degree '{degree}' from {institution} took {actual_years} yrs (maximum expected {max_years} yrs).

integrity_rules.description: Two full-time degrees with overlapping timelines.

credibility_rules.flag_message: last_active_date ({last_active}) is before signup_date ({signup}) — data integrity violation.

credibility_rules.description: Neither email nor phone is verified — profile authenticity unconfirmed.
All skills listed at the same proficiency level — likely bulk-fill, not genuine self-assessment.
credibility_rules.flag_message: All {count} skills listed as '{proficiency}' — possible bulk profile fill.

credibility_rules.description: Summary describes a completely different domain than current title suggests.
credibility_rules.flag_message: Summary domain appears inconsistent with current title '{current_title}'.

credibility_rules.description: Profile completeness score is very low, limiting signal reliability.
Submitting many applications but very low recruiter response — possible spray-and-pray.
credibility_rules.flag_message: {apps} applications in 30d with only {rr:.0%} recruiter response rate.

credibility_rules.description: Entire career at one company — limited exposure signal, not a disqualifier but noted.
credibility_rules.flag_message: Entire {years} yr career at single company '{company}'.
